summary: Iteration 54 testing complete. Both fixes verified: (1) Fix 1 - Send DC button correctly hidden for without_material SCs (line 517 condition o.subcontract_type !== 'without_material'), Create PO button shows for without_material SCs without job_work_parts, Send DC Parts button shows for Job OS SCs. (2) Fix 2 - BOM routing costs per operation working: routings stored as {name, cost} dicts, legacy string routings normalized to {name, cost: 0}, BOM explode returns process_cost_per_unit = sum of routing costs (verified 50+30=80), frontend form shows cost inputs per routing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 54 features verified: (1) Fix 1 - JobWorkPage.js line 517 correctly excludes Send DC button for without_material SCs. Line 520-521 shows Send DC Parts for Job OS (without_material with job_work_parts). Line 532-533 shows Create PO for without_material without job_work_parts. (2) Fix 2 - BOM routings now store {name, cost} dicts. normalize_routings() at server.py line 190 converts legacy strings to {name, cost: 0}. routings_total_cost() at line 204 sums costs. BOM explode at line 916 uses routings_total_cost as priority 1 for process_cost_per_unit. Frontend BOMPage.js shows cost inputs per routing (data-testid=parent-routing-cost-{i} and comp-{idx}-routing-cost-{ri}). Explosion table shows routings with costs in parentheses when cost > 0.

fix1_send_dc_parts_for_job_os.details: JobWorkPage.js line 520-521: Send DC Parts button shows for Job OS SCs (without_material with job_work_parts, lines empty). Verified via Playwright.

fix2_bom_create_with_routing_costs.details: POST /api/bom with routings=[{name:'LC Cutting',cost:50}] stores correctly. Verified parent_routings and component routings both store {name, cost} dicts.

fix2_bom_legacy_string_normalized.details: POST /api/bom with routings=['Assembly'] normalizes to [{name:'Assembly',cost:0}]. normalize_routings() at server.py line 190 handles this.

fix2_bom_explode_process_cost.details: GET /api/bom/{id}/explode returns process_cost_per_unit = sum of routing costs. Verified: LC Cutting 50 + Bending 30 = 80. total_cost_per_unit = material (100) + process (80) = 180.

fix2_bom_explode_routings_priority.details: BOM routing costs take priority over SC/WO-derived process costs. routings_total_cost() called first at line 916, fallback to SC/WO only if 0.

fix2_frontend_routing_cost_inputs.details: BOM form shows cost inputs per routing. Parent routings: data-testid=parent-routing-cost-{i}. Component routings: data-testid=comp-{idx}-routing-cost-{ri}. Process Cost / Unit total displayed.

fix2_frontend_explosion_table.details: BOM explosion table has Routings column and Process Cost/Unit column. Routings show name with cost in parentheses when cost > 0 (line 873 BOMPage.js).
